citations.claim: still NS yellow, 4th second of yellow
prematurely in all-red before EW - yellow only lasted 4s vs required 6s

counterfactual.change: Set actuated from true to false (one field) - disables actuated early termination so yellow runs full 6s and violation disappears

explanation: Actuated controller truncates yellow prematurely. Shrunk scenario has yellow_seconds=6 but NS yellow at steps 151-154 lasted only 4s, being cut to all-red at step 155. With actuated=false the same timings produce full 6s yellow and no violation, showing actuated gap-out/max-recall logic incorrectly preempts yellow.
vision_note: Steps 152-154 show two approaches with yellow signals while vehicles are in the intersection, and step 155 visibly switches all four approaches to solid red. The yellow phase is cut short to all-red while bodies are still clearing, breaking the required yellow hold time.
